result.summary: Found several layout and content clipping issues: truncated restaurant names, a partially cut-off category chip, and incomplete text on a popular restaurant card.

issues.description: The restaurant name 'Trattoria Piccol' is truncated/cut off at the end of the card in the 'Fastest near you' section.
issues.suggestion: Allow the title to wrap to two lines, reduce font size, or ensure the card width accommodates the full name without clipping.

issues.description: The last category filter chip ('Healthy') is only partially visible and cut off at the right edge of the screen.
issues.suggestion: Ensure horizontal scrolling affords a clear peek of the next chip, or add padding so chips aren't harshly clipped mid-label if more categories exist.

issues.description: The second popular restaurant card (pizza) shows only a discount badge and image with no visible restaurant name, rating, or delivery info in the current viewport framing—name may be missing or pushed below.
issues.suggestion: Verify card layout so title and metadata remain visible with the image, or ensure consistent card structure matching the ramen card above.
